review_provenance.evidence: A bounded fresh agent compared three visual systems against the exact five-slide copy and returned GO with no open doubts.

copy_lock.copy: She was throwing away her almosts.
He lined them up, oldest to newest.
She saw failures. He saw her becoming.
So she added today's unfinished page.

agents.prompt_summary: Extract visual mechanics from references without copying frames, likenesses, or exact labels.
Prove every locked slide through concrete Aachu/Zuv behavior, not decorative illustration.
Define wants, hidden needs, eye-lines, hands, posture, distance, and joke-to-tenderness movement.
Plan readable text and brandmark placement independently for every request-locked native output.
Translate the selected visual system into specific final-generation and integrated-text constraints.
Select one system only after scoring copy alignment, relationship proof, visual variety, identity, aspect safety, and sendability.

visual_system_candidates.name: The Folder Changes Hands
visual_system_candidates.case_for: One continuous clear-out is told through changing folder ownership, distinct camera jobs, her visible re-seeing, and her final voluntary addition.
visual_system_candidates.risk: A single room can feel repetitive unless every frame changes camera, action, focal evidence, and object state.

visual_system_candidates.name: Hands-Only Evidence Table
visual_system_candidates.case_for: Creates tactile suspense through hands, paper texture, folder edges, and object states.
visual_system_candidates.risk: Withholds the embarrassment-to-recognition turn and risks becoming premium stationery content.

visual_system_candidates.name: The Room Becomes a Museum
visual_system_candidates.case_for: Makes the working title visually immediate through framed exhibits or miniature plinths.
visual_system_candidates.risk: Manufactures a scrapbook fantasy, invites labels and micro-text, and turns him into the curator of her identity.

cross_debate: Keep the approved copy locked and make visuals do proof work.
Reject decorative quote-card scenes, generic couple stock poses, and repeated props.
Preserve the selected visual system unless visual-plan-quality records an explicit repair.
why_it_wins: The folder changes physical state on every slide, the full story survives without copy, and Aachu owns the final action rather than becoming a passive subject of Zuv's care.

slide_visual_blueprint.copy: She was throwing away her almosts.
slide_visual_blueprint.scene: Low box-level wide view in a lived-in home study corner during a clear-out. An open desk drawer and plain discard carton establish the action. A worn unlabelled folder has just landed in the carton. Aachu's right hand has released it while Zuv bends and retrieves its edge with a fully traceable right arm. Aachu faces the drawer and is already moving to the next item; Zuv's gaze and torso point only toward the folder. Exactly two people, no background figures, mirrors, portraits, silhouettes, or readable secondary text.
slide_visual_blueprint.must_show: Visible Aachu/Zuv relationship behavior that proves the exact copy.

slide_visual_blueprint.scene: Tactile close insert at floor level. The rescued folder lies open between them. Several dog-eared unfinished paper forms fan out: erased pencil marks, blank-line layouts, rough boxes and folded sheets, but no readable words, names, dates, applications, courses, employers, titles, grades or signatures. Aachu begins to draw the cover shut while Zuv leaves space and does not tug against her. Only lower torsos, connected forearms and knees enter frame. Exactly two people and no other figures or reflections.
slide_visual_blueprint.must_show: Visible Aachu/Zuv relationship behavior that proves the exact copy.

slide_visual_blueprint.copy: He lined them up, oldest to newest.
slide_visual_blueprint.scene: True overhead chronology view on the floor or low table. Zuv lays four or five visually distinct, non-readable sheets into a clean left-to-right progression. Paper wear and construction style shift subtly from older to fresher. Aachu sits opposite, watching with one hand held close to her knee. The chronology itself becomes the bridge between them. Exactly two people, no reflected or background figures, and no readable secondary text.
slide_visual_blueprint.must_show: Visible Aachu/Zuv relationship behavior that proves the exact copy.

slide_visual_blueprint.copy: She saw failures. He saw her becoming.
slide_visual_blueprint.scene: Over-Zuv-shoulder medium reaction view. Aachu is in sharp focus beyond the ordered papers. Her hand has released the folder cover and opened it flat beside the chronology. Her guarded posture softens into a quiet, startled half-smile. Zuv remains only a grounded shoulder and partial profile in the foreground. The paper line leads the eye from him to her face. No embrace, praise or explanatory gesture; the silence is the event. Exactly two people, no reflections or extra figures, no readable paper text.
slide_visual_blueprint.must_show: Visible Aachu/Zuv relationship behavior that proves the exact copy.

slide_visual_blueprint.copy: So she added today's unfinished page.
slide_visual_blueprint.scene: Low table-level close two-shot with the hand action in the foreground. Aachu slides a fresh, visibly unfinished but wordless page into the open final gap of the ordered row. Zuv has withdrawn his hands and watches from beside her. The rescued folder remains open behind the chronology. Aachu leans forward and owns the action; Zuv is close but not directing it, and both gazes converge on the new page. Exactly two people, no background figures, mirrors, portraits, silhouettes, labels, dates or readable secondary text.
slide_visual_blueprint.must_show: Visible Aachu/Zuv relationship behavior that proves the exact copy.
